detail: Installs a thin GitHub Actions workflow that calls the shared Swift quality gate in ForkHorizon/ci-gates: build, swift-format lint, and blocking Periphery dead-code detection. Pull requests scan changed files for format and the whole project for build/dead-code.

files.contents:
{
  "fileScopedDeclarationPrivacy": {
    "accessLevel": "private"
  },
  "indentBlankLines": false,
  "indentConditionalCompilationBlocks": true,
  "indentSwitchCaseLabels": false,
  "indentation": {
    "spaces": 4
  },
  "lineLength": 140,
  "maximumBlankLines": 1,
  "multiElementCollectionTrailingCommas": true,
  "respectsExistingLineBreaks": true,
  "rules": {
    "AllPublicDeclarationsHaveDocumentation": false,
    "AlwaysUseLowerCamelCase": true,
    "DoNotUseSemicolons": true,
    "FileScopedDeclarationPrivacy": false,
    "IdentifiersMustBeASCII": true,
    "NeverForceUnwrap": false,
    "NeverUseForceTry": false,
    "NeverUseImplicitlyUnwrappedOptionals": false,
    "NoAccessLevelOnExtensionDeclaration": false,
    "NoAssignmentInExpressions": true,
    "NoBlockComments": true,
    "NoEmptyTrailingClosureParentheses": true,
    "NoParensAroundConditions": true,
    "NoPlaygroundLiterals": true,
    "NoVoidReturnOnFunctionSignature": true,
    "OneVariableDeclarationPerLine": true,
    "OrderedImports": false,
    "ReplaceForEachWithForLoop": false,
    "ReturnVoidInsteadOfEmptyTuple": true,
    "TypeNamesShouldBeCapitalized": true,
    "UseEarlyExits": false,
    "UseExplicitNilCheckInConditions": true,
    "UseLetInEveryBoundCaseVariable": true,
    "UseShorthandTypeNames": true,
    "UseSingleLinePropertyGetter": true,
    "UseSynthesizedInitializer": true,
    "UseTripleSlashForDocumentationComments": true,
    "ValidateDocumentationComments": false
  },
  "tabWidth": 4,
  "version": 1
}

name: {{script_title}}

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Files to scan
        required: false
        default: all
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - changed
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 5 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: swift-quality-gate-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  swift-quality-gate:
    uses: ForkHorizon/ci-gates/.github/workflows/swift-quality.yml@main
    with:
      mode: ${{ inputs.mode || 'auto' }}
      config: .{{script_slug}}.json
      runs-on: '{{runner_labels_json}}'

pullRequestBody:
Adds {{script_title}} managed by CI Scope.

This PR adds:
- `.github/workflows/{{script_slug}}.yml`
- `.{{script_slug}}.json`
- `.ci-scope-swift-format.json`

The workflow calls the shared gate in `ForkHorizon/ci-gates`, so gate logic updates roll out from that repository automatically. It compiles the Swift project, enforces formatting, and runs blocking Periphery dead-code detection. File/function length checks stay in the separate Linter Checker 300 Lines script.
summary: Builds Swift projects and blocks formatting and dead-code regressions.
title: Swift Quality Gate
